SessionStart.description: Inject METHODOLOGY.md doctrine (decision-sizing triad + reasoning scaffold) into session context

UserPromptSubmit.description: Advisory: when user prompt looks like non-trivial engineering work, nudge /grilling → /to-prd → /to-issues → /ship-task

PreToolUse.description: Gate: block irrecoverable Bash patterns (rm -rf, push --force, --no-verify, reset --hard, clean -f)
Gate: block hardcoded /Users/<name> paths in .sh/.py files

Gate: ask the human to approve edits to verifier surfaces (hooks/gates/**, hooks/hooks.json) — the model cannot edit the gates that judge it (tamper-resistance). Emits permissionDecision: ask (no env-var bypass).

Stop.description: Stop: track cumulative token and cost metrics per session; appends to ~/.local/share/kbg/metrics/costs.jsonl
